prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1271; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with injuries sustained in a side-impact collision at an intersection. Our client was struck while proceeding through the intersection and has since sought medical treatment for injuries that are still being evaluated. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide a complete copy of the policy declarations page and confirm the bodily injury and property damage liability limits applicable to the insured driver. Please also confirm whether any other policies may provide coverage.

We further ask that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, vehicle data and event recorder information, dash camera footage, recorded statements, claim file materials, repair and total loss records, and any communications with third parties. Please ensure that no vehicle or related evidence is altered, repaired, or disposed of without prior written notice to this office.
